title: Delivery event v1
description: The record a driver's spoken account becomes. Used unchanged as the JSON Schema for the log_delivery_event tool. Three columns of evidence, kept apart: stated (the driver's words), observed (the device), proof (the recipient). Only the stated column is ever asked for. See docs/lastmile-spec.md section 3.2.

order_ref.description: Order ID resolved from the manifest

location.description: Stated. Where at the address it happened. The region pack supplies the words used to ask.

place.description: Estate, complex, building, block or landmark

entrance.description: Gate, lobby, buzzer, unit or door

notes.description: Anything else the driver volunteered about the location

recipient.description: Stated. Who took the parcel, when it was not the customer.

failure_reason.description: Stated. Required when the outcome is a failure or a refusal.

payment.description: Stated. Required when the manifest marks the order cash-on-delivery.

expected_amount.description: From the manifest, not from the driver

next_action.description: Stated. Required whenever the parcel did not reach the customer.

observed.description: Machine-observed facts. Never spoken, never asked for, not the driver's to edit.

gps_delta_m.description: Metres from the manifest drop address. Advisory. It never blocks a record.

stationary.description: Safety gate state at capture. Unknown when the device cannot report speed, see spec section 1.1.

scan_ref.description: Barcode, where the order was scanned

proof.description: Recipient-supplied evidence. Declared so the model is complete; out of scope for this build.

confidence.description: Per-field recognition confidence, keyed by dotted field path, used to route weak records to review. See spec section 3.3.

audio_ref.description: Turn-level citation: the driver turn that set the field. Not a word span. See spec section 3.4.

start_ms.description: Start of that turn, not of the word
